search_window.basis: After the last verified supplementary Gaza watch heartbeat, not the incident time. In Gaza local time the window begins 6 November about 09:44. Delayed indexing of reports published slightly earlier is eligible only when not previously captured.

findings.title: Two Palestinians succumb to wounds sustained in earlier Israeli airstrikes on Gaza
findings.location: Gaza City, Gaza Strip: Al-Shati refugee camp (Al-Balakhiyah), with earlier injury at Islamic University campus
findings.affected_population_system: Two Palestinians who died from prior strike injuries: Sara Abu Jiyab, an Islamic University medical student, and Nabil Hamad
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Two Palestinians died on Friday from wounds sustained in separate Israeli airstrikes targeting Gaza City, according to medical sources.
findings.source_type: Established Palestinian news agency citing hospital and medical sources; Arabic edition from same publisher is not independent corroboration
findings.confidence: medium-high for reported deaths; exact death times and independent corroboration unavailable
